provenance: Per spell: `provenance` says where the name/identity comes from, `source` cites it, every level has its own `provenance` for its numbers. Ids are the client's spell ids (icon clips/spells/icons/<id>.swf, lang S[id]) as identified by the lang reconstruction (web/public/lang/fr.json, docs/content-reconstruction.md). `anim` (clips/spells/<anim>.swf) and `launch_type` are authored (the pairing is UNKNOWN in the client): types 10/11 never wait on the spell SWF, 30/31 use arc SWFs ended by launchToArc. Range 0 + on_itself = the descriptions' 'PO : -1' (self). Levels 2-5 are authored (+1 to dice bonuses per level) unless tagged otherwise.
